notes: Both retrieved titles and DOIs match the supplied references. Original source is the author accepted manuscript, so page numbering differs from published p.54. The supplied locator does not identify Colour versus Threat/negative facial expressions; no unique target test can be established, so es and p are null and target_match is null on both sides. Original candidate results: manuscript p.8, lines 182–183, Colour: “the primary test—the interaction between Current Probe Location and Previous Probe Location—was significant, F(1, 143) = 91, p < .0001, ηp2 = 0.39”; manuscript p.9, lines 192–193, Threat: “the interaction between Current Probe Location and Previous Probe Location was also significant, F(1, 143) = 8.5, p = .0042, ηp2 = 0.056.” Replication candidate results: article p.565, Results, Colour: “the carryover eﬀect was conﬁrmed, F(1, 130) = 63.39, p < .001, h2p = 0.33”; same page, facial expressions: “the carryover eﬀect was conﬁrmed, F(1, 130) = 21.88, p < .001, h2p = 0.14”. The n values apply to both candidate tests and agree with the printed denominator df; they are not generic enrollment totals. Authors explicitly describe replication of both candidate effects in the Study 1 discussion. No statistics converted. Unsolicited forbidden-domain search snippets appeared in the general DOI search results; no forbidden page was opened or used.
